questions.stem: A 35-year-old male patient is brought to the hospital with an altered state of consciousness. He has a history of chronic liver disease. On examination, there are mild ascites and tremors. Laboratory values show: Total Bilirubin - 2.5 mg/dL Albumin - 3 g/dL INR=2.0 According to the given data, the patient belongs to which class of Child Turcotte Pugh score?
